title: Victor Monolith AGI System v3.2.2

authors.name: Brandon 'iambandobandz' Emery
authors.affiliation: Massive Magnetics / Ethica AI / BHeard Network

description: Experimental persistent AGI organism featuring hierarchical predictive coding mesh, MPC consciousness loop, identity core with directive management, long-term memory with vector retrieval, and tiny MoE transformer decoder for local generation.
abstract: Victor Monolith v3.2.2 implements a unified cognitive architecture combining neuroscience-inspired hierarchical predictive coding with control-theoretic model predictive control for consciousness. The system maintains persistent identity through recursive self-reflection and deterministic anchoring, stores experiences in a hybrid SQLite/FAISS memory system, and generates contextually-grounded responses via a retrieval-augmented mixture-of-experts transformer decoder. This represents 2 years of research into AGI architectures that balance autonomy, coherence, and adaptability.
objectives: Implement hierarchical predictive coding for perceptual inference
Integrate MPC for conscious planning and decision-making
Maintain persistent self-referential identity with minimal drift
Build scalable long-term memory with semantic retrieval
Create controllable local generation via MoE decoder
Demonstrate belief-based reasoning with directive prioritization
Establish asynchronous architecture for real-time operation

methodology.approach: Unified cognitive architecture combining bottom-up perception (predictive coding), top-down planning (MPC), memory consolidation (vector embeddings), and action generation (MoE decoder)

Future work includes scaling to real-world applications, multi-agent coordination, and online learning capabilities.
